title: Pushout of the etale torsor extension
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, let $G\to G'$ be a morphism of abelian sheaves on $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$, and let $0\to G\to E_T\to\mathbf Z_S\to0$ be the canonical extension attached to a $G$-torsor $T$ by [lem-sc-torsor-h1]. Form its pushout $E_T\wedge^G G'$ along $G\to G'$. Then the pushout is a short exact sequence $0\to G'\to E_T\wedge^G G'\to\mathbf Z_S\to0$, and its fibre over $1$ is canonically the contracted-product $G'$-torsor $T\wedge^G G'$.
